title: workplan_research_decision_response
description: Response schema for the workplan research agent declaring whether it has enough context to hand off to planning, and carrying its findings forward.

decision.description: Use 'needs_input' when you posted one or more clarifying questions this turn and are stopping before research is complete. Use 'ready' when you have enough context to hand off to planning - 'findings' then carries everything the planner needs.

findings.description: Markdown running summary of what you know so far: the work item's real ask (including any answers already received), relevant codebase context you found (files/patterns/conventions), and assumptions already resolved. Keep this current on every turn, including 'needs_input' turns, so a resumed run - or the planner, once 'ready' - can pick up without re-deriving it.
